content:
**Shipped PR 1 of the Brain UI surface: state vocabulary, provenance stamps, the token block**

What: lib/state-vocab.mjs (nine node states as code + word + mark + class, colour.mjs delegating), lib/provenance.mjs (sourceLabel moved, sourceStamp with [repo:], [forge: #n], [git:], [link:] forms, https-only hrefs), the app.css token block (light base on :root, the design's dark palette under prefers-color-scheme, system font stacks), and the innerHTML guard. Why: issue #998, the first of six chained PRs on feature/issue-998-ui-surface implementing the maintainer's Claude Design; rulings of 2026-09-16 (system fonts, verdicts not node states, six tabs, prefers-color-scheme). Where: brain/scripts/ui/lib/{state-vocab,provenance,colour,drawer-model}.mjs, brain/scripts/ui/static/{app.css,tokens.test.mjs,app-source-guard.test.mjs}, openspec/changes/issue-998-ui-surface/. Learned: applied inline by the orchestrator because both sub-agent models hit their limits; each unit red first with one mutation. sourceLabel keeps the plain form so six drawer-model assertions and the current page stay byte-identical; the stamps are a second function.
source: engram save on gandalf-ROG-Zephyrus-G15-GA503QR-GA503QR; actor from git config brain.actor; actorKind agent from env AI_AGENT=claude-code_2-1-270_agent; issue 998 declared via --issue
